title.en: Beachcomber Quiz: What Catches Your Eye?
title.zh: 海边拾趣：什么会吸引你停下？

description.en: Six shoreline illustration choices about noticing patterns, tracing an object’s story and deciding what to leave in place. Find your beachcomber portrait.
description.zh: 在六个海岸插画场景里，留意图案、追想物件故事、决定把什么留在原处，发现你的海边拾趣画像。

title.en: What Kind of Birdwatching Companion Are You?
title.zh: 观鸟同行：你会怎样分享一次发现？

description.en: Six choices in a fictional birdwatching club about waiting, recording a sighting and sharing it without making the outing a competition.
description.zh: 在虚构观鸟小组里做六次选择：等待、记录发现、分享见闻，让一次外出不必变成比赛。

title.en: What Kind of City Wanderer Are You?
title.zh: 在城市里闲逛，你会沿什么线索走？

description.en: Six city-walk choices reveal the thread you follow: spatial patterns, neighborhood rhythms, or layers of local stories. All original portraits free.
description.zh: 6道城市闲逛选择题，看看你会追踪空间结构、街区节奏，还是地方故事的层次。原创完整画像免费。

title.en: What Do You See in the Drifting Clouds?
title.zh: 看云小游戏：你会看见什么？

description.en: Six visual imagination choices turn drifting clouds into a picture, a moving scene or a space left open. No weather prediction or hidden-trait reading.
description.zh: 六次视觉想象，把浮云变成一张画面、一段移动场景，或一片留白。不预报天气，也不解读隐藏特质。

title.en: What Kind of Coffee Break Do You Actually Want?
title.zh: 你真正想要哪种小憩？

description.en: A six-question break-time quiz about a change of scene, a small sensory ritual, or easy company. No coffee required and no health claims.
description.zh: 6道小憩情境题，看看你更想换个场景、享受一个感官小仪式，还是找人轻松聊聊。不必喝咖啡，不涉及健康判断。

title.en: Design an Imaginary Oasis Rest Stop
title.zh: 设计你的想象绿洲歇脚站

description.en: Six fictional design choices about clear orientation, a memorable welcome and room to rest. Discover the rest stop your choices build.
description.zh: 六次虚构设计选择，安排清楚指引、值得记住的欢迎和可安静休息的位置，看看你会建出怎样的歇脚站。

title.en: What Kind of Desk Reset Fits You?
title.zh: 你的桌面想怎样重新开始？

description.en: Six creative-workspace choices find your reset portrait: ready stations, a portable kit, or a clear stage. A playful preference quiz, not an organization grade.
description.zh: 6道创作桌面选择题，看看你更适合准备好的小站、可移动工具包，还是一块清爽舞台。不评判整洁能力，完整结果免费。

title.en: What Kind of Dragon Housemate Would You Be?
title.zh: 和一条龙合住，你会怎么相处？

description.en: Six original scenes about a friendly dragon roommate reveal how you share a home: clear zones, small rituals, or collaborative inventions. All portraits free.
description.zh: 6个与友好龙室友合住的原创情境，看看你会划清空间、建立小仪式，还是一起做发明。完整画像免费。

title.en: The Dream Train’s Changing Ticket
title.zh: 梦境列车：会改字的车票

description.en: Follow three to four choices through an original train tale. A ticket that changes one word can become a keepsake, a shared letter or the name of a new station.
description.zh: 用3至4次选择走进原创列车短篇。一张会改一个字的票，可能成为纪念、共同信件，或新站的名字。完整结局免费。

title.en: The Enchanted Library: Which Clue Will You Trust?
title.zh: 会改写的图书馆：你会相信哪条线索？

description.en: Follow three to four choices through a library with conflicting catalogues. Find an original ending about checking evidence, asking its keeper, or leaving uncertainty open.
description.zh: 在目录互相矛盾的图书馆做3至4次选择。你会核对证据、询问保管者，或把不确定留在原处？完整原创结局免费。

title.en: What Is Your Fantasy Adventure Party Role?
title.zh: 奇幻冒险队里，你负责什么？

description.en: Choose through six original fantasy expedition scenes to find your party role: route scout, ward keeper, or spell tinkerer. All story results are free.
description.zh: 走过6个原创奇幻远行情境，看看你是探路斥候、结界守护者还是咒语修补师。所有故事结果免费。

title.en: The Paper-Firefly Evening
title.zh: 纸萤火的傍晚

description.en: Follow three choices through a temporary paper-light exhibition. Choose a final signal, a shared display or a quiet closing scene in an original story.
description.zh: 用三次选择走过临时纸灯展。在原创故事中，选择最后的信号、共同展示或安静闭场，完整结局免费。

title.en: Where Would Your Floating House Belong?
title.zh: 漂浮小屋：你会怎样与地面相连？

description.en: Six original fantasy choices about a house that can drift, stay tethered or make short visits. Explore how this imaginary home connects with places.
description.zh: 六次原创幻想选择，让能漂浮的小屋漫游、系泊或短暂靠访，探索它会怎样与地方保持联系。

title.en: The Forest’s Missing Last Note
title.zh: 森林乐曲失去的最后一音

description.en: An original branching forest tale in three to four choices. Follow a broken rhythm to an echo, a chorus or a deliberate quiet ending.
description.zh: 用3至4次选择走进原创森林分支短篇。沿着断开的节奏，走向回声、合奏，或主动留下的安静结尾。

title.en: Which Season Is Your Imaginary Garden In?
title.zh: 你的想象花园正在哪个季节？

description.en: Choose among six garden scenes about beginning, tending, gathering and resting. Find the season your choices give this fictional garden today.
description.zh: 在六个花园场景里，选择开始、照料、收集与休整，看看今天的选择会把这座虚构花园带到哪个季节。

title.en: What Is Your Group Chat Role?
title.zh: 你在群聊里是什么角色？

description.en: Six everyday messaging choices reveal your chat contribution: signal keeper, spark starter, or quiet connector. Free full results without an account.
description.zh: 6道日常聊天题，看看你更像信息整理员、话题点火者还是安静的连接者。无需账户，完整结果免费。

title.en: One Day on Postcard Island
title.zh: 明信片岛的一天

description.en: Follow three choices through an original island story. A silent bell, an unfinished mural and a ferry ledger lead to three different keepsakes.
description.zh: 跟随三次选择走进原创小岛故事。无声的钟、未完成壁画与渡船簿，通向三件不同纪念。完整结局免费。

title.en: What Kind of Kitchen Improviser Are You?
title.zh: 厨房临场发挥时，你是哪一派？

description.en: Six fictional dinner decisions explore how you adapt when ingredients, time, and tastes do not line up. Find your improvising style, not a cooking skill grade.
description.zh: 6道虚构晚餐选择题，看看食材、时间和口味对不上时，你怎样调整。不评价厨艺，完整结果免费。

title.en: What Is Your Missing-Keys Search Style?
title.zh: 钥匙一时找不到，你会怎么找？

description.en: Six harmless misplaced-object scenes explore your search story: replay the sequence, scan the space, or use another perspective. This is not a memory or ability test.
description.zh: 6道物品暂时找不到的小情境，看看你会回放经过、扫描空间，还是借助另一种视角。不测试记忆力或能力，完整结果免费。

title.en: The Lost Letter: Which Story Ending Will You Choose?
title.zh: 失落的信：你会走向哪种故事结局？

description.en: A free two-to-three-choice branching adventure at a floating post office. Follow your own route to an original ending, with no random outcome.
description.zh: 在漂浮邮局完成2至3次选择，沿真正的故事分支走向原创结局。无随机抽取，完整结局免费。

title.en: What Kind of Magic Shopkeeper Would You Be?
title.zh: 如果开一家魔法小店，你是哪种店主？

description.en: Six original magical-shop scenes find your shopkeeper portrait: the careful labeler, the lending librarian, or the small-wonder demonstrator. Every result is free.
description.zh: 6个原创魔法小店情境，看看你是认真贴标签的店主、愿意借出魔法的馆员，还是演示小奇迹的人。完整结果免费。

title.en: The Moon Market: What Will You Bring Home?
title.zh: 月亮集市：你会带什么回家？

description.en: Follow two to four choices through an original moonlit market. Your route ends with a borrowed star map, a garden of possibilities, or a ticket back to now.
description.zh: 用2至4次选择走过原创月光集市。你的路线会带回借来的星图、可能性花园，或一张回到此刻的车票。完整结局免费。

title.en: Your Role in a Shared Mountain Cabin
title.zh: 山间小屋：你会怎样安顿这一晚？

description.en: Six fictional cabin choices about essential supplies, making the common room comfortable and agreeing on personal space. Find your shared-cabin portrait.
description.zh: 在六个虚构小屋场景里，准备基本用品、布置共同房间、约定个人空间，发现你会怎样安顿这一晚。

title.en: What Would You Label in the Museum of Tomorrow?
title.zh: 明日博物馆：你会怎样写展签？

description.en: Six choices about explaining invented future objects through their purpose, their possible users and their limits. Build an original exhibition-label portrait.
description.zh: 六次选择，围绕虚构未来物件的用途、可能使用者与限制，写出你的原创展签画像。

title.en: What Kind of Museum Visitor Are You?
title.zh: 逛博物馆时，你会怎样看？

description.en: Six exhibit choices reveal your visiting rhythm: looking closely, following connections, or making meaning together. Free portraits for a more personal museum day.
description.zh: 6道展览情境题，看看你偏向细看一件、追踪关联，还是与人共同理解。免费获得更贴近自己的观展画像。

title.en: What Would You Notice in the Night Garden?
title.zh: 夜色花园：你先留意什么？

description.en: Six illustrated night-garden scenes follow quiet sounds, changing shadows and tiny details. Discover your style of attention inside this fictional walk.
description.zh: 六幅夜间花园插画，跟随细小声音、变化影子和微小细节。发现你在这段虚构漫步里选择的注意方向。

title.en: How Would You Talk with a Paper Creature?
title.zh: 纸小兽不会说话，你会怎样交流？

description.en: Six original fantasy encounters about learning gestures, mirroring a movement and taking turns with a wordless paper creature. No real animal training involved.
description.zh: 六次原创幻想相遇，和不会说话的纸小兽学手势、照着动作试一试、轮流回应，不涉及真实动物训练。

title.en: What Kind of Playlist Maker Are You?
title.zh: 你的歌单会怎样照顾一段时间？

description.en: Six playlist decisions explore three original curating styles: a story arc, shared-room energy, or surprising discoveries. No genre stereotypes or copyrighted song excerpts.
description.zh: 6道歌单选择题，探索故事弧线、照顾现场或发现惊喜三种策划方式。不按曲风贴人格标签，不使用歌曲摘录。

title.en: The Pocket Portal: Where Will Your Choices Lead?
title.zh: 口袋传送门：你的选择会通往哪里？

description.en: A free branching adventure with three to four choices per route. Explore an original portal story and reach a lantern harbor, unfinished gallery, or postcard home.
description.zh: 每条路线3至4次选择的原创分支冒险。走进口袋传送门，抵达灯笼港、未完成画廊，或寄回家的明信片。完整结局免费。

title.en: Which Reward Would You Choose After a Tiny Quest?
title.zh: 完成一场小冒险后，你最想带走什么奖励？

description.en: Six original quest-reward choices lead to a map for tomorrow, a sunset feast, or a token worth keeping. A free fantasy preference game with full portraits.
description.zh: 6道原创冒险奖励选择题，看看你会带走明日地图、落日宴席，还是值得留着的小信物。免费奇幻偏好游戏，完整画像直接可读。

title.en: Your Rainy-Window Sketchbook
title.zh: 雨窗速写本：你会画下哪一层？

description.en: Six visual framing choices about a window’s foreground, reflections and the distant scene. Find the illustrated view your sketchbook keeps.
description.zh: 六次视觉取景选择，围绕窗前物、玻璃倒影与远处景象，看看速写本会留下哪一层画面。

title.en: What Is Your Reading Ritual?
title.zh: 你会用什么方式走进一本书？

description.en: Six recreational reading scenes explore how you choose, pause, and return: one world, a trail of books, or a small recurring appointment. Full results free.
description.zh: 6道休闲阅读情境题，看看你如何选书、停下与重新回来：沉入一个世界、串起几本书，还是保留小小的阅读约定。完整结果免费。

title.en: Which Response Color Leads Your Choices?
title.zh: 回应颜色：哪种方式在你的选择里更常出现？

description.en: 24 paired choices about everyday responses. Compare four original color directions with raw counts and complete tied results; no norms, diagnosis or commercial color system.
description.zh: 24组成对日常回应选择，以原始计数比较四个原创颜色方向，完整呈现并列结果；无常模、不诊断，也不对应商业四色体系。

title.en: The Paper River: How Will You Cross?
title.zh: 纸上河流：你会怎么过河？

description.en: Six choices on a tabletop river map about testing a route, coordinating a crossing and choosing a workable pace. A fictional puzzle, not outdoor safety advice.
description.zh: 在桌面河流地图上做六次选择，试路线、协作过河、安排节奏。这是虚构小游戏，不提供真实户外安全建议。

title.en: The Secret Door: What Will You Do with the Key?
title.zh: 秘密门：你会怎么使用这把钥匙？

description.en: Make three choices about an unexpected key, an invitation and a room that belongs to someone else. Discover one of three original story endings.
description.zh: 围绕意外得到的钥匙、一份邀请和他人的房间，做3次选择。发现三个原创故事结局之一，完整结果直接呈现。

title.en: Build a Snow-Day Sculpture in Your Imagination
title.zh: 雪日造型师：你会堆出什么？

description.en: Six illustrated snow-building choices about stable forms, surprising characters and a scene that can change. Discover your original snow-sculpture style.
description.zh: 六次插画堆雪选择，搭稳形状、创造角色、让场景继续变化。发现你的原创雪雕玩法，不需要真实下雪。

title.en: What Kind of Souvenir Story Do You Keep?
title.zh: 你会留下怎样的纪念？

description.en: Six keepsake choices explore what makes a reminder meaningful: continued use, a specific memory, or a story shared with someone. No purchase required.
description.zh: 6道纪念物选择题，看看什么让提醒变得有意义：继续使用、一段具体记忆，还是与人共享的故事。不必购物，完整结果免费。

title.en: Which Original Spell-School Elective Would You Choose?
title.zh: 原创魔法学校里，你会选哪门课？

description.en: Six playful class decisions place you closest to one of four original electives: teacup weather, pocket architecture, echo letters, or floating shapes. Full results free.
description.zh: 6道轻松选课题，看看你更靠近杯中天气、口袋建筑、回声书信，还是漂浮形状。四门课均为原创，完整结果免费。

title.en: Your Role at an Imaginary Stargazing Night
title.zh: 想象观星夜：你会带来什么？

description.en: Six choices about a fictional sky gathering: finding patterns, giving them stories and making an evening easy to join. No astronomy knowledge required.
description.zh: 围绕一场虚构星空聚会做六次选择：找图案、讲故事、让夜晚容易参与。不需要天文学知识。

title.en: Which Original Storybook Narrator Is Yours?
title.zh: 你的原创故事书，会由谁来讲？

description.en: Six storytelling choices find your narrator: the close-up lens, the village chorus, or the sideways wink. A free style game, not a writing ability test.
description.zh: 6道讲故事选择题，看看你的叙述者更像近景镜头、村庄合唱，还是侧着眨眼的旁白。免费风格游戏，不评价写作能力。

title.en: Which Tide-Pool Neighbor Would You Be?
title.zh: 潮池邻居：你会是哪种小生物？

description.en: Six imagined low-tide situations about sharing shelter, making room and responding to a crowded pool. Meet your original tide-pool neighbor portrait.
description.zh: 在六个想象中的退潮场景里，选择如何共用遮蔽处、腾出空间、面对拥挤潮池，发现你的原创潮池邻居画像。

title.en: Which Tiny Kingdom Would You Build?
title.zh: 如果王国只有一个鞋盒大，你会建成什么样？

description.en: Six miniature-world choices lead to an original kingdom of exchanges, experiments, or well-kept promises. A playful design portrait, with every result free.
description.zh: 6道微型世界选择题，看看你的原创小王国更像交换集市、试验工坊，还是承诺档案馆。趣味设计画像，完整结果免费。

title.en: What Is Your Weekend Pace?
title.zh: 你的周末节奏是什么？

description.en: Six low-stakes planning scenes explore what makes a weekend feel yours: a few anchors, room for surprises, or protected breathing space. All results free.
description.zh: 6道轻松的安排题，看看怎样的周末更有自己的感觉：有几个锚点、容纳惊喜，还是守住留白。完整结果免费。

title.en: Which Woodland Animal Matches Your Trail Style?
title.zh: 你的林间同行动物是什么？

description.en: A free six-question woodland animal quiz about exploring, making a base, and protecting your pace. Read your complete animal portrait immediately.
description.zh: 6道林间情境题，看看你更像开路、搭窝还是留意节奏的同行动物。免费查看完整画像。
